text:
Maria Chen: Quick ask — we're in Fremont next Wed, ~12 ppl. Looking for brunch spots that are group-friendly and have dog-friendly patios. Any recs? :dog: :pancakes:
Kevin O'Rourke: Everyday Brunch Haus on 34th has a back patio, big tables. good for groups. https://everydaybrunch.example.com/menu
Jamal Khan: +1 Everyday. They do family-style platters and can do a round of check splitting if you ask.
Anne L.: There's also Porch & Pines — amazing avocado toast and big outdoor bench seating. Slightly pricier.
Liam: If anyone's gluten-free, The Green Fork nearby has GF pancakes and a small fenced patio. Not huge tables tho.
Sarah: For 12 I might call ahead. lunchbot: poll created: "Which place should we call?" options: Everyday Brunch Haus / Porch & Pines / The Green Fork — vote with `:one: :two: :three:`
Kevin O'Rourke: I can call and reserve 2 tables and ask about merging them. free after-hours so I'll do it at 11am.
Maria Chen: Amazing, thanks Kevin. Also FYI two people bringing dogs (small), one vegetarian, one full GF.
Jamal Khan: If they won't seat 12 together, we can do staggered seating or pre-order family platters. Caviar pickup is also an option.
Anne L.: Here's a quick snippet of the menu for Everyday Brunch Haus: `Family Platter (serves 6): $48 — eggs, potatoes, pancake stack, mixed fruit`
Liam: I'll handle payments on site if we split via Venmo. Sound good? :money_with_wings:
Sarah: I'm in for Venmo. If Kevin gets the reservation, drop the confirmation here and I'll pin it.
Kevin O'Rourke: Called and left a voicemail — they can hold two long tables for 12 at 11:45am with dogs on the patio. Will confirm tomorrow. Phone ref: (555) 322-1144
Maria Chen: Perfect. If they confirm, I'll do the Google Calendar invite and note dietary needs. Thanks all! :heart:
lunchbot: Reservation reminder set for Tue 10:00am to confirm — I'll ping this thread.
Kevin O'Rourke: Confirmed via text — all set. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: nailed it. See you there! :croissant:
